dek: The following is issued on behalf of the Liquor Licensing Board: The Liquor Licensing Board will meet on Tuesday (September 1) to consider the revocation of the liquor licence of The Point in Tsim Sha Tsui. The meeting will be held at 9.45am in the conference room, Room 102, 1/F, 258 Queen's Road East, Wan Chai. Member
